title: Genesis Garden
palette: deep ultramarine, vivid but tasteful teal, radiant honey gold, pale opal light
scene: An original surreal primordial creation-garden at first-person eye level, environmental concept rather than an illustration of any existing card. A broad solid pale mineral path curves from bottom center LEFT through shallow azure pools and soft jade terraces. On the RIGHT, a colossal living mineral tree unfurls branching golden light into a vast blue cavernous sky; fluid ribbons of light and cloud seem to seed new foliage across the valley. Far away, irregular floating stone shelves and gentle waterfalls. Asymmetrical composition, winding navigable route, no central triangle, no figures, no humanoid forms. Serene ecstatic wonder, blue-and-gold resonance, luxurious painterly pixel colors.
wall: flat muted ultramarine mineral stone with fine branching ochre-gold veins
floor: flat pale opal limestone with quiet blue-gray hairline cracks and faint warm mineral specks
secondary: flat luminous deep cerulean water surface with fine soft gold ripple streaks, no reflected scene
detail: flat deep teal living bark with restrained branching gold mineral fibers
concept_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production biome concept for Recurant, a first-person fantasy exploration game. Create a gorgeous refined painterly pixel-art landscape in the spirit of richly colored early-1990s Lands of Lore environments, with deliberate pixel clusters, elegant atmospheric color and warm/cool relationships; not muddy, not cheap flat vector art, not photorealism. Landscape 4:3 composition, intended native 320x240 pixels with readable clusters. Full image, no frame, UI, text, labels, signatures, logos, people, creatures, weapons or first-person hands. Clearly navigable floor, eye-height first-person view, no aerial or isometric camera. Original composition, do not copy any existing game or card image. atlas_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual diffuse material texture atlas for a low-resolution first-person fantasy game, NOT concept art. Produce exactly ONE square image divided precisely into a 2 by 2 grid of FOUR equal borderless square texture swatches, filling every pixel. TOP LEFT: flat muted ultramarine mineral stone with fine branching ochre-gold veins. TOP RIGHT: flat pale opal limestone with quiet blue-gray hairline cracks and faint warm mineral specks. BOTTOM LEFT: flat luminous deep cerulean water surface with fine soft gold ripple streaks, no reflected scene. BOTTOM RIGHT: flat deep teal living bark with restrained branching gold mineral fibers. Each is a distinct close-up FLAT ORTHOGRAPHIC SURFACE, not an object, scene, panel, cube, tile slab or perspective floor. Material surfaces alone; absolutely no horizon, scenery, shadow-casting objects, bevelled borders, text, labels, frame, gutters, gaps or margin. Neutral even ambient illumination across each square; no vignette, bright center or directional gradient. Quiet low-frequency painterly pixel texture and intentional hand-painted clusters, refined rich early-1990s fantasy color, intended to downsample crisply to 256x256 per swatch. Palette: deep ultramarine, vivid but tasteful teal, radiant honey gold, pale opal light. All four swatches should tile seamlessly on their own along both axes: match corresponding opposite edges, avoid singular center motifs, keep detail small and distributed, continue organic patterns across boundaries. Each quadrant must remain entirely its own material, sharp boundary exactly at the 50% horizontal and vertical midpoint. Do not depict four scenic landscapes. Do not paint objects on a background. Original work.
